summary: Zeo Energy Corp. filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026 disclosing Amendment No. 1, dated August 20, 2026, to its January 27, 2026 Common Stock Purchase Agreement with White Lion Capital, LLC. The amendment grants the Company sole discretion to set a floor price for shares sold under Accelerated Purchase Notices, previously unallowable. The $30.0 million at-the-market-style equity purchase facility remains unchanged and non-binding. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation transaction is involved; this is an ordinary financing-contract amendment. Watch dilution from future drawdowns and any Nasdaq minimum-price constraints.
